message.content: I’m not sure which “Doe vs. Smith” case you’re referring to—there may be several with that name. Could you let me know the year (and, if possible, the state or court) when the case was decided?

But we don't have the year or location. The function requires case_name, case_year, and optional location. We only have case_name "Doe vs. Smith". We need the year. We could ask clarifying question: "Which year did the case take place?" Or we can attempt to guess? The user didn't provide year. According to instructions, if insufficient info, ask clarifying question. So we should ask: "Could you please specify the year of the case?" Also maybe location. So we ask clarifying question.
